_comment: Tags verified on ollama.com/library on 2026-10-01. Sizes are Ollama download sizes. Run `python -m benchmark models` to check what is pulled locally. Models marked think=false are reasoning models whose hidden 'thinking' must be disabled so every model answers under the same output budget.
